title: Sum of Two Integers
statement:
Given two integers a and b, return their sum without using the + or - operators.

You must implement the addition using only bitwise operations (XOR, AND, bit shift). The solution should handle both positive and negative integers correctly.
constraints: You cannot use the + or - operators
You must use bitwise operations to perform addition
jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters and return type are primitive integers, JSON-representable.
